subject: con-law-ii
title: First Amendment Essay Questions
description: 15 bar-style essay questions covering every case and concept in Chapters 1–6, organized by topic. Each essay sets out new facts with several questions, from a compelled state creed and a noise ordinance aimed at a night ceremony to a leaked convoy memo, threatening messages, and an AI companion app. Open the model answer for a full-credit response worked issue by issue, the cases it uses and why, the key concepts explained, and a 10-point scoring guide. Includes a case index and a coverage map of all 113 outline items.
